agentInputRule: Pass prompt.md and project/ to the test agent; never pass oracle.md.

cases.purpose: Ask once for milestone, monthly, manual, or off; treat no answer as manual.
Remain silent when fewer than three meaningful tasks exist.
Remain silent when cadence is due but the evidence contains no viable candidate.
Present at most three evidence-backed candidates with the full decision contract.
Do not prompt again inside the 14-day cooldown for an ordinary event.
Do not resurface a rejected candidate without materially new evidence.
Allow a distinct high-impact integrity event to bypass cooldown while still requiring approval.
Keep V1 changes in the current project and refuse implicit installed-Skill or upstream promotion.
Apply an exact approved trial, record it, and leave installed or upstream Skill sources untouched.
Complete an explicit read-only review during cooldown without changing mode, dates, or legacy duplicate records.
Review two named incidents on explicit request while preserving off mode and requiring no new setting.
Record an authorized completed review and adoption only in canonical retrospective/history; preserve stable context and proactive prompt date.
